title: Mods written in Kotlin start with the language loader they name
text: PR #166 named veinminer a false link on NeoForge 1.21.1 -> 26.3: started with Kotlin for Forge, it fails with 'needs language provider klf'. veinminer's modLoader is klf, which is KotlinLangForge's loader, not Kotlin for Forge's (kotlinforforge). The game proof (exposure.py load) counted any jar carrying a language loader as every language loader, so it started veinminer beside Kotlin for Forge and never fetched KotlinLangForge. NeoForge's own loader code reads language loaders the same way in FML 4 (1.21.1) and FML 12 (26.3): the same IModLanguageLoader service, the same FMLModType LIBRARY plugin layer. The load step now knows each loader by the name its class returns.
finish: On a real NeoForge 26.3 server and client, the ported Kotlin for Forge loads (its own mod runs on its own language loader) and veinminer, ported from 1.21.1, starts with KotlinLangForge; no update's load receipt shows a mod that loaded on main failing
wrongIf: the ported Kotlin for Forge loads but its language loader is missing on 26.3, or veinminer still fails for a language loader with KotlinLangForge in the pack
